params.body:
Closes #1159

## What changes

**Name of the website embed.** "Voorraad op de website" becomes "Wagens op je website" in every place where it names the embed:
- the `/docs` menu (`DocsController::PAGES`);
- `docs/integraties.md`, `docs/website-embed.md` and the link in `docs/api/partner-api.md`;
- `embed_title`, `embed_code_help` and the mail subject and body in `resources/lang/nl/website.php`;
- the preview page title and heading ("Zo staan je wagens op je website").

R S2-5.20 quotes the heading and the mail subject, so it follows. The two embed tests assert the new text.

**`own_first`.** The parameter now says it only applies with `scope=all`, and that without `scope` only the dealer's own vehicles come back. The change is in both the OpenAPI document and `public-api.md`.

Not changed:
- the `data-title` default `Voorraad` of the embed script, which is the frame's accessible name;
- "voorraad" where it means stock in general (insights, momentum).

## Checked

Full suite: 3376 tests, no failures.
params.title: Call the website embed "Wagens op je website"; explain own_first without scope
